title: Enterprise Postgres - From Prototype to Production
excerpt: Start in the pgEdge cloud. Deploy in our cloud, your cloud, or on-premises, including air-gapped environments.
content_html:
pgEdge Starfleet · Enterprise Postgres Cloud

Start in the pgEdge cloud. Deploy in our cloud, your cloud, or on-premises, including air-gapped environments.

  • 14-day free trial
  • No credit card required
  • From $25/month

Trusted where reliability isn’t optional

Motorola Solutions

See pgEdge Starfleet in action.

Create a database, connect AI tools, branch, and move to production—all on 100% standard Postgres.

From empty database to AI application in minutes.

Provision a database

Create a Postgres database in under two minutes.

Connect AI agents

Give agents governed database access through the built-in MCP server.

Add RAG and similarity search

Use pgvector, hybrid search, and RAG with your Postgres data.

Create branches

Isolate agent experiments, or clone production databases for testing.

Move to production

Deploy on the exact same Postgres platform, wherever production needs to happen.

Start in our cloud.  Run in yours when you need to.

Run on pgEdge Starfleet in the pgEdge cloud or in your cloud. If production requirements demand it, the same pgEdge Postgres platform runs self-hosted on infrastructure you manage.

Build AI on Postgres, not around it.

Everything developers need to connect agents, add hybrid search and RAG capabilities, and experiment in parallel - without assembling a second data stack.

Let agents work directly with Postgres.

Connect Claude Code, Cursor, Replit, and other agentic tools through the built-in MCP server. Rely on pgEdge SafeSession to enforce true read-only access.

Add hybrid search and RAG

Add vectors with pgvector, and utilize BM25 hybrid search. Use the built-in RAG server to build a full RAG pipeline within Postgres, without additional tools or external data pipelines.

Give every agent and pull request its own database.

Create copy-on-write branches for agentic experiments, development, testing, staging, and GitHub workflows—all in their own isolated Postgres instances. Built on top of the time-tested Postgres storage engine.

Ready for production when your application is.

Start with developer speed. Move up to the security, compliance, reliability, and data sovereignty your environment requires.

Secure by default

Database infrastructure is protected by IP allowlisting rather than exposed to the public internet.

Governed agent access

Guardrails within the MCP Server along with pgEdge SafeSession ensure agents operate with just their assigned permissions. And readonly is truly readonly.

High availability

Scale to highly available clusters on pgEdge Starfleet BYO Cloud or on-premises with multi-region automated failover and optional active-active replication.

Zero-downtime maintenance

Maintenance and software upgrades happen on pgEdge Starfleet BYO Cloud or on-premises without application downtime.

One single platform

Run the same exact Postgres platform across our cloud, your cloud, and your on-premises infrastructure.

Your Postgres skills, tools, and extensions come with you.

pgEdge Starfleet runs on standard, unforked Postgres. Not “Postgres compatible”, and no non-standard storage layer. The applications you build, extensions you use, and expertise your team already have all transfer over to pgEdge Starfleet.

No database fork

No proprietary storage layer

No replatforming

Create your first database in under two minutes.

Explore pgEdge Starfleet free for 14 days. No credit card required.

Starting at:

$25/month

Frequently asked questions

Is pgEdge Starfleet built on standard Postgres, or a fork?

pgEdge Starfleet runs on 100% standard, open source community Postgres—not a fork, and with no proprietary or non-standard storage layer.

What is the difference between pgEdge Starfleet Managed and BYO Cloud?

Managed runs fully managed on pgEdge-hosted infrastructure. BYO Cloud deploys pgEdge Starfleet and your databases on dedicated infrastructure inside your own AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud account.

Which agentic coding tools does the MCP server support?

pgEdge Starfleet connects with tools including Claude Code, Cursor, and Replit, with governance guardrails built in.

How does database branching work?

pgEdge Starfleet creates copy-on-write branches on standard Postgres storage running in their own isolated Postgres instances. They can be used for agentic experiments, development, testing, staging, and GitHub workflows.

What does it cost?

Start with a 14-day free trial with no credit card required. Paid plans begin at $25 per month and scale with instance size.

What if I need on-premises, air-gapped, or distributed deployment?

pgEdge Starfleet runs on the same pgEdge Enterprise Platform we offer for self-hosting, giving you a supported path to on-premises, air-gapped, and highly available distributed deployments.

Build at AI speed.   Run anywhere.

Start for free with pgEdge Starfleet Managed, or talk to us about BYO cloud or self-hosted deployments
